SELECT COUNT(1) AS totalMsgCount, SUM(CASE WHEN status = #{status} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS publishedMsgCount, SUM(CASE WHEN status != #{status} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS unpublishedMsgCount, SUM(CASE WHEN reply_content IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS totalReplyCount, ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN reply_content IS NOT NULL THEN interact_rate ELSE 0 END),2) AS avgInteractRate FROM communicate_mgmt WHERE deleted = 0
AND create_time between #{startTime} AND #{endTime}
SELECT DATE_FORMAT(reply_time, '%Y-%m-%d') AS date, COUNT(1) AS count FROM communicate_mgmt WHERE deleted = 0 AND (reply_time between date_sub(now(), interval 7 DAY) and now()) GROUP BY date
